thesis: Europe's most liquid storage market, with no capacity revenue for a four-hour battery. Merchant four hours is the best design at 13.9% hold, and a toll is how a fund secures it at 11.7%. The open risk is the storage grid-fee framework, still a draft.
欧洲流动性最好的储能市场，但四小时电池没有容量收入。纯市场化四小时是最佳设计，持有期回报13.9%；基金可通过租赁锁定收入，回报11.7%。尚未落定的风险是仍为草案的储能电网费框架。

reason: Third of seventeen markets on hold IRR, 13.9%.
持有期IRR为13.9%，在十七个市场中排第三。
assetReturn.author: analyst

reason: The reference project secures nothing; a five-year toll on 80% of a 300 MW battery was announced in June 2026, so a secured route has been signed in the market.
参考项目没有任何锁定收入；2026年6月公布了一份为期五年、覆盖一座300MW电池80%容量的租赁协议，说明该市场已有项目签下锁定收入的途径。
revenueCertainty.author: analyst

reason: At transmission level a EUR 1,500 per MW deposit is posted on accepting a connection offer, before consent is required and before the project is built; with the EUR 50,000 fee that is at least 0.24% of project cost, and development spend and any early tranche of the connection contribution are not counted.
在输电网层面，接受并网要约时即须按每MW 1,500欧元缴纳保证金，此时既不要求已取得许可，项目也尚未建设；连同5万欧元申请费，至少占项目投资的0.24%，前期开发支出以及并网工程费分摊可能提前支付的部分均未计入。
capitalAtRisk.author: analyst

trendCause: From April 2026 the four transmission operators replaced first-come, first-served with a published procedure and published scoring criteria.
自2026年4月起，四家输电运营商以公开的程序和评分标准取代了先到先得。
reason: The transmission operators publish the process, the minimum requirements, the scoring criteria, the cycle dates and the capacity available at each connection point. The procedure is in its first cycle, and distribution-level connections are outside it.
输电运营商公布了流程、最低要求、评分标准、周期日程以及各并网点的可用容量。该程序尚处于第一个周期，配电网层面的并网不在其范围内。
approvalTransparency.author: analyst

trendCause: Transmission connection requests from large batteries reached 211 GW by the third quarter of 2025, against about 51 GW of commitments issued.
截至2025年第三季度，大型电池提出的输电网并网申请已达211GW，而已发出的并网承诺约为51GW。
reason: Capacity is allocated by a maturity ranking in fixed cycles. The operators say demand will go on exceeding supply, and applications still queued under the old rule are transferred into the new procedure.
容量按成熟度排序、分固定周期分配。运营商表示需求仍将持续超过供给，按旧规则仍在排队的申请将转入新程序。
gridScarcity.author: analyst

reason: Investment review reaches a non-EU acquirer of a company that operates a critical facility. The published threshold for a storage plant is 104 MW, above the 100 MW reference project; a review once opened has four months to decide, which is longer than ninety days.
投资审查适用于非欧盟投资者收购关键设施运营企业的情形。储能设施的公开门槛为104MW，高于100MW的参考项目；审查一旦启动，须在四个月内作出决定，超过九十天。
foreignEntry.author: analyst

reason: The regulator's framework for storage grid fees is a consulted draft with a decision intended in 2026; which projects keep relief, and for how long, depends on it.
监管机构的储能电网费用框架仍是已征询意见的草案，拟于2026年作出决定；哪些项目可继续享受减免、期限多长，均取决于该决定。
policyStability.author: analyst

text: The modelled merchant return is among the highest on the platform.
模型测算的市场化回报在本平台各市场中居前。
Connection requests far exceed capacity and are now ranked by maturity, which protects a project that already holds a connection.
并网申请远超容量，现按成熟度排序分配，这对已持有并网权的项目形成保护。
Lenders are financing storage portfolios here.
贷款人正在为这里的储能资产组合提供融资。

despite: The storage grid-fee framework is still a draft, and merchant revenue has to carry the case alone.
储能电网费用框架仍为草案，而整个投资逻辑只能靠市场化收入支撑。

scoreNote: The score crosses into enter-now only because the return grade rose a fifth when Finland fell below Germany in the ranking; Germany's own return did not change. The reference toll play is below the fund's target both ways, and a reference project secures nothing until it holds a toll, so the call stays opportunistic.
评分进入“现在进入”区间，仅因芬兰在排名中降至德国之后、德国回报评级上升一档；德国自身回报并未变化。参考租赁方案在两种口径下均低于基金目标，且参考项目在签订租赁协议前没有任何锁定收入，因此结论维持“机会型”。

并网申请远超容量，现按成熟度排序分配，这对已持有并网权的项目形成保护。
A deposit is posted before allocation is certain, and the larger connection contribution follows.
在容量分配确定之前即须缴纳保证金，其后还有金额更大的并网工程费分摊。

despite: A fresh application joins an oversubscribed ranking with no assurance of an offer.

developer.author: analyst

label: First capacity round storage can enter without a long-duration test
储能无需满足长时要求即可参加的首轮容量招标
Merchant · 4h
市场化 · 4小时
why: Merchant four hours is the best design in Germany: the fifth and sixth hours earn less than they cost.
纯市场化四小时是德国的最佳设计：第五、第六小时的收益低于其成本。

text: Develop four-hour merchant projects and keep the option to toll at ready-to-build.
开发四小时纯市场化项目，并在具备开工条件时保留签订租赁的选择。

de-mer-4h.author: analyst

label: Toll · 4h
租赁 · 4小时
why: No capacity revenue exists for a four-hour battery; a five-year toll secures it at 11.7% hold, against 13.9% merchant.
四小时电池没有容量收入；五年期租赁可锁定收入，持有期回报11.7%，纯市场化为13.9%。

text: Shortlist ready-to-build projects with a signed toll or floor; check the storage grid-fee draft before pricing.
筛选已签租赁或保底合同、具备开工条件的项目；定价前核查储能电网费草案。
